subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should maintainers require live Feishu tenant proof before adopting the known Feishu-local parser fix for this issue?
rationale: The source-level bug and likely fix boundary are clear, but prior same-fix PRs closed because no live Feishu proof or explicit proof override was available.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted proactive `message(action=send)` or `thread-reply` run showing the JSON renders as an interactive card before adopting or merging a fix.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept source-level tests and review evidence for this credential-gated external API path and then adopt one of the known candidate fixes.

options.title: Keep paused
options.body: Leave the issue open without a new automated fix PR until someone with Feishu access can validate the behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted proactive `message(action=send)` or `thread-reply` run showing the JSON renders as an interactive card before adopting or merging a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent Feishu proactive send and native-card payload work and already repaired one candidate branch for this issue.
